## `scripts/audio_director.gd`

class_name `GridFallAudioDirector` · extends `Node`

Dynamic ACE-Step 1.5 soundtrack crossfader & crisis SFX director. Crossfades between gridfall_nominal.wav (96 BPM) and gridfall_blackout_crisis.wav (122 BPM) based on real-time city blackout intensity. On foot (set_fp(true), called by slice I's audio feature) the stems play on the Music bus 8 dB lower and keep playing, muffled, while the tree is paused; UI cues move to the UI bus and the incident alert gives way to positional sirens.

### Signals

- `sfx_played(path: String, bus: String)`: A play_sfx call actually played (tests count these instead of listening).

### Constants

- `NOMINAL_TRACK_PATH = "res://sounds/music/gridfall_nominal.wav"`
- `CRISIS_TRACK_PATH = "res://sounds/music/gridfall_blackout_crisis.wav"`
- `SFX_TICK_PATH = "res://sounds/placement-a.ogg"`
- `SFX_ALERT_PATH = "res://sounds/gridlock_alert.wav"`
- `SFX_RECOVERY_PATH = "res://sounds/upgrade_chime.wav"`
- `SFX_DAY_BELL_PATH = "res://sounds/day_bell.wav"`
- `TICK_MIN_GAP = 10.0`: Shortest gap between two blackout ticks, in seconds of director time.
- `FP_MUSIC_OFFSET_DB = -8.0`: On foot: music offset under the street sound, the buses used and the UI cue trim.
- `FP_MUSIC_BUS = &"Music"`
- `FP_UI_BUS = &"UI"`
- `FP_UI_TRIM_DB = -6.0`

### Functions

- `func set_blackout_intensity(intensity: float, phase: String = "") -> void`: Crisis level for the music crossfade. The tick cue sounds only when phase changes, and at most once per TICK_MIN_GAP seconds (it used to sound on every call, i.e. every day start).
- `func toggle_mute() -> bool`
- `func set_fp(on: bool) -> void`: On-foot routing (slice I). true: stems on the Music bus with FP_MUSIC_OFFSET_DB, UI cues on the UI bus, the incident alert suppressed, and the director runs while paused. false restores the orbit routing and process mode exactly.
- `func is_fp() -> bool`
- `func get_active_stem_label() -> String`
- `func play_sfx(path: String, volume_db: float = -6.0) -> void`

## `scripts/cinematic.gd`

class_name `Cinematic` · extends `Node`

Scripted ~30 s trailer for social posts. Drives the camera through the mayors, the residents, a construction row and nightfall, with captions and a ticker of live GMI mayor calls. Grow a city first with GRIDFALL_CINEMATIC=prep, then record with Movie Maker: GRIDFALL_CINEMATIC=record godot --path . --write-movie out.avi --fixed-fps 30 --resolution 1920x1080

### Constants

- `SAVE = "user://gridfall_cinematic.json"`
- `FONT = preload("res://fonts/lilita_one_regular.ttf")`

- `PREROLL_MAX = 45.0`
- `GOLD = Color("#FFB800")`

## `scripts/main.gd`

extends `Node3D`

GridFall: a SimCity-style city run by five autonomous GMI Cloud AI mayors. Wires the tile simulation, the GMI brain, the 3D city view, the HUD, camera and audio.

### Constants

- `SAVE_PATH = "user://gridfall_save.json"`
- `TOOL_MODES = [ "GRIDFALL_CINEMATIC", "GRIDFALL_SMOKE_TEST", "GRIDFALL_PHOTO_DIR", "GRIDFALL_FP_SMOKE...`: Environment switches that make a run a tool run (trailer, smokes, photo tours).
- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`

### Properties

- `fp: FpMode`: First-person composition (null in orbit mode). Built by enter_fp(), freed by exit_fp().
- `view_mode: String`: "orbit" or "fp"; tools and saves can read it.
- `autosave_enabled: bool`: Autosaves (the first tick of each morning, quitting) are on only in normal play: tool runs, tests and the benchmark never touch the player's city.
- `autosave_path: String`: Where autosaves go; tests point it away from the player's slot.

### Functions

- `func save_game(path: String = SAVE_PATH) -> bool`
- `func autosave(reason: String) -> bool`: Saves the city to autosave_path while autosave_enabled. reason: "morning" (a small toast) or "quit" (silent: the window is closing).
- `func quit_game() -> void`: The pause menu's Quit: saves the city, then quits.
- `func load_game(path: String = SAVE_PATH) -> bool`
- `func new_game() -> void`
- `static func wants_fp() -> bool`: True when this run will play in first person: no legacy tool mode (cinematic, orbit smoke, orbit photo tour) is selected, and either an FP tool mode is or GRIDFALL_VIEW is not "orbit". Mirrors the boot ladder in _ready(), so the early view flag and enter_fp() always agree.
- `func focus(p: Vector3, dist: float, reason: String = "") -> void`: Draws attention to a world point. Orbit: moves the camera rig (old behaviour). First person: never teleports; emits GameBus.ping(p, reason) for the HUD and minimap. reason: "event:<type>" | "resident:<id>" | "tile" | "auto:tile" | "district:<mi>" | "" .
- `func notify(text: String, kind: String = "info") -> v`: Player-facing notice: CityHud toast in orbit, GameBus.toast in first person. kind: "info" | "alert" | "success" | "system".
- `func active_camera() -> Camera3D`: The camera the city view should use for picking and shake.
- `func enter_fp() -> void`: Switches to first person (S0 §6.3). Safe to call twice.
- `func exit_fp() -> void`: Back to the orbit view and CityHud (used by B's "Quit to orbit"). Safe to call twice. It frees FpHud, so a caller inside an FP node's signal (a Button's pressed) must use ctx.main.call_deferred("exit_fp"); a locked object cannot be freed mid-emit.
- `func grow_offline(days: int, cap_ms: int) -> void`: Grows the city offline at full speed with the legacy 12 s day, for tests and tours, then restores the current day length and speed 0. The caller must have called sim.start(). Returns when sim.day >= days or after cap_ms of wall clock time.

## `scripts/save_slot.gd`

class_name `SaveSlot` · extends `RefCounted`

One saved city on disk, written so a crash or a full disk mid-save never costs the player their city: the new save goes to <path>.tmp first, the previous one moves to <path>.bak, and only then does the new file take the slot's name. read() falls back to the backup when the slot is missing or unreadable (a crash between the two renames, or a truncated file).

### Functions

- `static func write(path: String, data: Dictionary) -> Error`: Writes data as JSON to path. OK, or the error that stopped it (the slot is then unchanged).
- `static func read(path: String) -> Dictionary`: The saved city at path (or its backup), or {} when neither holds one.
- `static func exists(path: String) -> bool`
- `static func backup_path(path: String) -> String`
